test_pddl_conversion: test the puzzle_to_pddl conversion by running Fast Downward on generated PDDL domain and problem files
run_fast_downward_planner: run the Fast Downward planner on a PDDL domain and problem file to find a solution plan
check_pddl_solution: check that a PDDL puzzle generates a correct plan when a solution exists
convert_puzzle_to_pddl: convert a PushWorld puzzle to PDDL domain and problem descriptions for planning
verify_pddl_plan_execution: verify that a discovered PDDL plan achieves the goal state in the puzzle
